units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 1:34">Ex. R. s. 1</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Exodus 2:24">Ex. II, 24</cite>) <he>נַאֲקַת החללים</he> the groaning of the wounded.
Ex. R. s. 6; a. e.—Esp. n’aḳah (prayer in distress), one of the expressions for prayer. Lam. R. introd. (R. Ḥănina); Sifré Deut. 26; Deut. R. s. 2; a. e.
